title: Evaluate dotfiles for refinements and improvements
description:
Comprehensive review of dotfiles configuration to identify opportunities for refinements, changes, and improvements.

## Non-negotiables
- **helix** - Must remain as editor
- **zellij** - Must remain as terminal multiplexer

## Scope
- Review current configurations
- Identify outdated or unused settings
- Consider modern alternatives where appropriate
- Optimize workflows and keybindings
- Document any changes made
